Session Review

Grade the read, not just the result.

After the close, review the session and each trade with structure: execution quality, focus, mindset, the concepts in play, and an honest reflection. The post you share carries your morning bias with it.

  • Execution quality, focus and close tagged per session
  • Concepts & mindset tags that feed your statistics
  • Per-trade reflections with chart snapshots
  • Review post embeds the morning bias and mode

Series of 10

See your edge in tens.

A single trade tells you nothing. Ten tells you plenty. Session Tool groups your trades into rolling series of ten so variance stops masquerading as skill — and so a bad run reads as a sample, not a verdict.

  • Win / loss / break-even mapped across each block of ten
  • Net R and account % per series
  • Series history so you can compare runs over time
  • Export a series summary straight to the community

Risk Rules

Rules you set. Rules it holds you to.

Define five guardrails per account in percent or currency. Session Tool watches the day against them — and when you cross one, the greeting that meets you doesn't congratulate you. It tells you, plainly.

  • Max drawdown, daily drawdown, risk per trade, profit target, max trades
  • Set each in % or £, per account
  • Live banners and greetings flag a breach as it happens
  • Works across multiple accounts and prop challenges

MT5 Auto-Sync feature

Your trades, logged the moment they close.

Run the Minimalist Manager EA and every trade you close in MetaTrader 5 flows straight into your journal — entry, exit, risk, result and P&L already filled in. You just add the why. A Premium feature, synced through your account.

  • Closed MT5 trades arrive in your log automatically
  • Direction, result, risk, R and P&L pre-filled from the trade
  • No CSV exports — it syncs through your account
  • You add the type and the notes; the facts are already there

And the quiet details

Everything else that earns its place.

Multi-account

Track every account and prop challenge side by side, each with its own balance, rules and statistics. Scope the whole app to one account, to a linked group, or to all of them at once — and archive the ones that are over without losing a single trade.

Academy

Two things in one tab. The Trading Academy is a forty-lesson course on the method — the first two modules are open on every plan, Free Trial included; the rest come with Bundle Pro. The Media Vault, a library of walkthroughs, weekly reviews and live-session replays, lands soon.

Community

A community built into the app — channels, DMs and live-session chat, plus 1:1 voice and video calls with screen share and live drawing, so you can take a chart apart together while you both draw on it. No second app, no second login.

AI Assistant

An AI trading coach built into every tab — it knows your numbers, answers questions about your performance, and reads the charts you paste in, screenshot or link. It greets each session with something that actually lands, rather than a line it could have written for anyone.

Economic calendar

The day's high-impact releases, filtered to the currencies you actually trade, so red-folder news never blindsides the session. Actual, forecast and previous sit side by side once the number lands — so you can see whether it beat expectations, not just that it happened.

Live market TV

A Bloomberg TV floater and a live markets ticker, so the macro tape sits right beside your journal. Pop the video out into its own window, pin the ticker to the top of every tab, and choose which symbols run across it — forex, indices, metals or crypto.

Trade Replay

Watch your executed trades play back candle-by-candle on real market data — TradingView charts with your entry, stop and target marked, plus drawing tools to study exactly how each one played out. The same trade, weeks later, without going to hunt for the chart.

TradingView & MT5 tools

The Minimalist SMC indicator and the Minimalist Manager EA — companion tools from the same workshop. The EA pushes every closed trade straight into your journal and feeds the live session panel while you are still in the trade, so nothing has to be typed in twice.

The Session Tool community

Built for the room, not the marketing page.

Session Tool grew out of a Discord channel, where it became clear that the community's most successful traders were the ones who held themselves accountable for their actions — bias in the morning, review at the close, everything shared in the same channel. The two companion tools come from the same place.

Comes with Session Tool

Two free companion tools from the same workshop, made to sit alongside the journal — set your charts and your terminal to match how you review.

TradingView · Pine v6

Minimalist indicator

Premium & discount zones, volume profile to identify where liquidity is held, previous Day/Week/Month highs & lows, sessions, market-open gaps and yearly quarters — a clean SMC overlay, published free on TradingView.
MetaTrader 5

Minimalist Manager EA

A trade-management utility for MT5 that unleashes the full potential of your journal, published on the MQL5 Market — open trades, choose your SL size and TP, and once you're in a trade, automate the move to break-even. Set a max trades-per-day limit to stop you from over-trading.
